projectTrajectoriesHelperModal.content:
Following the work on your interests, motivations and values, and on the exploration of possible futures, one or several life project ideas may start to take shape.
##The validation phase of your project(s) can then begin.##
The questions to ask yourself at this stage are:

(-##What skills have I already acquired that are useful for this project?##)(-##What new skills do I need to acquire to carry out this project?##)(-##How can I acquire them?##)
The answers to these questions will help you ##build one or more coherent paths for your project by combining several possible future profiles## (training programs, mobility, careers, etc.) that you have added to your portfolio.
##To support your reflection, you can associate evidences you have added to your skills portfolio.## These evidences will help demonstrate your learning and contribute to showing your commitment and progress in:

(-the development of your skills)(-the construction of a life project consistent with your background, skills, and interests.)
